title: 637301 Report layout override lifecycle
summary: Report layout overrides for extension-installed layouts now write Tenant Report Layout Override records with lifecycle properties (status, description, obsolescence) scoped per field and per company, preserving existing company-level overrides while offering copy as an escape hatch.
key_points: Extension layouts now create override records instead of copies, leaving originals visible
Status changes and edit info writes apply to all companies by default via override records
Scope is resolved per field, so description-only or obsolete-only overrides don't force status changes into wrong scope
Company precedence preserved: existing company-level overrides stay in that company on further changes
Only modified fields are written to overrides; no-op edits create no records
